parse.title: UFC on ESPN: Holm vs. Bueno Silva
parse.text: UFC on ESPN: Holm vs. Bueno Silva (also known as UFC on ESPN 49 and UFC Vegas 77) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on July 15, 2023, at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.[2]
